messages:
maria-ops: Planning a brief midnight maintenance: staggered NIC microcode refresh + graceful node drains in ap-south1 and us-east2. Window: 2025-06-03 00:00-02:00 UTC. Cohorts: 2 nodes per region every 20m. Pre-seed KV 30m prior.
kevin-sre: Can we run a 5m network canary before each cohort? If packet loss >0.3% rollback. I'll automate probes.
anya-runtime: Please push routing-policy to prefer local warm-fallback. Also set max-batch-size down to avoid long queuing during backfill.
jess-support: I'll prep status page and targeted notices for any customers with p95 <100ms SLA. Post at 23:30 UTC?
maria-ops: Affected pools: shared-ap-south, shared-us-east2. No dedicated disruptions. ops-bot: calendar event created: nic-microcode-midnight (2025-06-03 00:00-02:00 UTC). Ref #INC000862345.
kevin-sre: Runbook snippet:
```
# canary
kubectl cordon canary-01
kubectl drain canary-01 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --grace-period=30
sleep 300
# probe
curl -f http://internal-probe/ping || rollback
```
anya-runtime: Cost impact estimate: token backfill ~0.25% for window. Tagging billing to observe. If >0.6% abort.
jess-support: Draft blurb: "Rolling NIC refresh in ap-south1 & us-east2 00:00-02:00 UTC. Minor latency variance possible; no data loss." Posting at 23:30.
maria-ops: Final checklist: pre-seed 23:30, first canary 00:00, cohort cadence every 20m. I'll report canary metrics in-thread. :thumbsup:
